children: TXNM Energy priced a 7,079,646-share offering at $56.50 per share, raising about $400M gross and netting ~ $396M to repay its $400M term loan.
Undertook an underwritten offering of 7,079,646 common shares, priced at $56.50 per share.
Gross proceeds were ~ $400 million; company received net proceeds of approximately $396 million.
Company intends to use net proceeds to repay borrowings under its $400 million term loan agreement.
Offering closed on September 2, 2026, with Wells Fargo Securities as sole book-running manager.
